Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 6, Verse 5

“Let a person lift himself by himself and not degrade himself. For the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is its enemy.”

The most self-reliant verse in the Gita, spoken by a god to a devotee. Krishna makes plain that nobody else can perform the lifting, not even the one giving the advice.
